heading: Israeli raids, attacks, arrests continue in occupied West Bank and Gaza
body: Settler raids and attacks in the occupied West Bank, often under Israeli police protection, continued on Friday.

heading: More Araghchi quotes from call with UK counterpart
body: We now have more quotes from Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi during his phone call with UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband, according to Iran’s Tasnim news.

heading: WATCH: The US faces a strategic ‘dead end’ in Iran, analyst says
body: Washington has reached a strategic impasse with Iran, says a former analyst for the US Congress.

heading: WATCH: Israeli settlers vandalise Palestinian cemetery in West Bank
body: Israeli settlers vandalised a Palestinian cemetery, smashing stonework marking the graves of deceased Palestinians, during a march near the village of Tal in the occupied West Bank.

heading: US faces critical shortage of missile defence interceptors: Report
body: Months of conflict in the Middle East have left the Pentagon facing a diminishing supply of missile defence interceptors, prompting military planners to consider whether the US can maintain its current cadence of retaliatory strikes, Fox News reports.

heading: Is Israel really ready to withdraw from Gaza?
body: Thursday’s agreement stipulating that Hamas disarm and Israel withdraw from Gaza has gotten a frosty reception from Israeli politicians and the Israeli press.
